text: Fixed. The `enumerate(itertools.tee(seq, n), 1)` started indexing at 1, causing each of the `n` tee'd iterators to have one extra element skipped via `itertools.islice(it, i)` (i.e., the last iterator skipped `n` elements instead of `n-1`), which dropped the first window entirely. Changed `enumerate(..., 1)` to `enumerate(...)` (starting at 0) so the i-th iterator skips exactly `i` elements (0 through n-1), correctly staggering them to produce all `L - n + 1` overlapping windows starting from the first element.

final_text: Fixed. The `enumerate(itertools.tee(seq, n), 1)` started indexing at 1, causing each of the `n` tee'd iterators to have one extra element skipped via `itertools.islice(it, i)` (i.e., the last iterator skipped `n` elements instead of `n-1`), which dropped the first window entirely. Changed `enumerate(..., 1)` to `enumerate(...)` (starting at 0) so the i-th iterator skips exactly `i` elements (0 through n-1), correctly staggering them to produce all `L - n + 1` overlapping windows starting from the first element.
